lethalbreed.command.plague.cannot_infect: %s cannot be infected (a zombie, or contamination is disabled).
lethalbreed.notice.config_problems: %s problem(s) in the structure of config/oas/lethalbreed.json:
lethalbreed.notice.unknown_ambiguous: '%s' — did you mean '%s'? Too ambiguous to repair on its own.
lethalbreed.notice.duplicated: '%s' is written in two categories — only one copy is read.
lethalbreed.option.varHealthMin.desc: Lower bound of the per-zombie random max-health multiplier.
lethalbreed.option.varHealthMax.desc: Upper bound of the per-zombie random max-health multiplier.
Fire ticks applied on each daylight burn (160 = 8s).
lethalbreed.option.leapMaxVerticalDiff.d: Max vertical offset (blocks) to the target for a leap to fire.
lethalbreed.option.blockOpsEnabled.desc: Master switch for all breaking/bridging/pillaring (off = pure vanilla pathing).
lethalbreed.option.maxConcurrentBreaks.d: Cap on simultaneous progressive breaks per dimension (anti-TPS-lag).
lethalbreed.option.breakProtectBlockEnti: Never break blocks with a block-entity (chests, furnaces, spawners, beds).
lethalbreed.option.breakDropsItems.desc: Broken blocks drop their items (off = no item-entity spam on raids).
lethalbreed.option.targetPlayersOnly.des: Only acquire players as targets (ignore villagers, animals, other mobs).
lethalbreed.option.tickBuckets.desc: Stagger buckets for the tick scheduler (zombies/N updated per tick).
lethalbreed.option.autoScaleBuckets.desc: Pick bucket count from population automatically (overrides Tick Buckets).
lethalbreed.option.autoScaleBucketLoad.d: Target zombies processed per tick when auto-scaling.
lethalbreed.option.aiTickBudget.desc: Max full AI updates per tick (0 = unlimited).
Max vertical distance for neighbour/sound queries (0 = ignore Y).
lethalbreed.option.lodHysteresis.desc: Slack (blocks) before a zombie downgrades LOD tier (anti-flip).
lethalbreed.option.lodHardFreezeRadius.d: Beyond this from any player, freeze without reclassifying (0 = off).
lethalbreed.option.frozenReclassifyDivis: Frozen zombies reclassify 1 tick in N (higher = cheaper idle crowds).
lethalbreed.option.lodMediumNavMultiplie: Medium-LOD re-paths every Nav Reissue x this.
lethalbreed.option.lodLowNavMultiplier.d: Low-LOD re-paths every Nav Reissue x this.
lethalbreed.option.msptThrottle.desc: Under server lag, temporarily halve AI rate until it recovers.
lethalbreed.option.msptThrottleThreshold: Server MSPT (ms) above which throttling kicks in.
lethalbreed.option.spatialCellSize.desc: Spatial hash cell size in blocks (XZ).
lethalbreed.option.lodLow.desc: Distance for minimal AI; beyond it zombies stop ticking.
lethalbreed.option.throttleByLod.desc: Scale AI frequency by distance to save CPU.
Medium-LOD zombies run AI 1 tick in N.
lethalbreed.option.lodLowTickDivisor.des: Low-LOD zombies run AI 1 tick in N.
lethalbreed.option.useGpu.desc: Use the GPU solver when available (else CPU).
lethalbreed.option.flowCpuThreads.desc: CPU threads for the flow field (0 = auto).
lethalbreed.option.flowVerticalTolerance: Vertical search window for a surface.
lethalbreed.option.navSpeed.desc: Movement speed when following the flow field.
lethalbreed.option.flowBreakCost.desc: Path cost to break through a block (lower = break more).
lethalbreed.option.flowBuildCost.desc: Path cost to bridge a gap with dirt.
lethalbreed.option.flowOrthoCost.desc: Step cost for straight moves (10 = 1 block). CPU & GPU.
lethalbreed.option.flowResampleOnMoveDis: Skip recompute until focus moves this far (0 = off).
lethalbreed.option.gpuMinCells.desc: Min grid cells before using GPU (smaller = CPU). 0 = always GPU.
lethalbreed.option.gpuAutoCalibrate.desc: Benchmark CPU vs GPU at boot to auto-pick the threshold.
lethalbreed.option.gpuDeviceIndex.desc: Pick GPU by index (see boot log). -1 = auto.
Min progress (blocks²) that avoids the stuck counter.
lethalbreed.option.climbThreshold.desc: Build stairs when target is this far above.
lethalbreed.option.climbHorizRadius.desc: Only climb within this distance of the target.
lethalbreed.option.climbGiveUpCooldown.d: Wait before retrying a given-up climb.
lethalbreed.option.pillarMaxHeight.desc: Give up a pillar-up after this many blocks.
lethalbreed.option.pillarJumpPower.desc: Upward velocity of each pillar jump.
lethalbreed.option.targetDetectRadius.de: Detection radius for acquiring a target.
lethalbreed.option.requireLineOfSight.de: Need line of sight to see a target (else heard).
lethalbreed.option.forceNearestTarget.de: Always retarget the nearest living entity.
lethalbreed.option.targetMemoryTicks.des: Keep chasing a lost target's last spot (ticks).
lethalbreed.option.failOnAiConflict.desc: Hard-stop if another zombie-AI mod is found.
lethalbreed.option.leapChance.desc: Chance to leap on an eligible activation.
lethalbreed.option.randomEffectEnabled.d: Some zombies carry a random buff for life.
lethalbreed.option.randomEffectChance.de: Fraction of spawns that get an effect.
lethalbreed.option.randomEffectMaxAmplif: Max level of the random effect.
lethalbreed.option.leapEffectPerLevel.de: Extra leap reach per Leap-effect level.
lethalbreed.option.specialBaseChance.des: Base chance a spawn is special.
lethalbreed.option.specialShowName.desc: Show the special type as a floating name.
Zombie hits can infect with a slow, uncurable-by-milk plague.
lethalbreed.option.contamBaseChance.desc: Base infection chance on a hit.
lethalbreed.option.contamReanimateHumano: Dead contaminated humanoids rise as zombies.
lethalbreed.option.contamDevTimeScale.de: Divides every plague timer. 1.0 = normal; lower values make the contamination progress faster.
lethalbreed.option.maxBreakHeight.desc: Max vertical blocks a zombie breaks to pass.
lethalbreed.option.forceAllZombiesSunBur: All zombie types burn in daylight (incl. husks).
lethalbreed.option.floatInWater.desc: Float and swim at the surface instead of sinking.
lethalbreed.option.waterDiveSpeed.desc: Downward speed when diving after a target.
lethalbreed.option.waterSwimSpeed.desc: Horizontal swim speed toward the target.
lethalbreed.option.soundEnabled.desc: Zombies hear and investigate real noise.
lethalbreed.option.soundBaseRadius.desc: Base hearing radius for a normal sound.
lethalbreed.option.soundMoveThreshold.de: Min movement to emit a footstep sound.
lethalbreed.option.soundArriveDistance.d: Distance counted as reaching the source.
lethalbreed.option.stuckActivations.desc: Activations of no progress before acting.
lethalbreed.option.climbJumpMaxAge.desc: Abort a pillar rung that gains no height in this many activations.
lethalbreed.option.descendThreshold.desc: Dig down when target is this far below.
lethalbreed.option.safeDropBlocks.desc: Drops this short are walked, not carved.
lethalbreed.option.preventFallDamage.des: Cancel fall damage for smart zombies.
lethalbreed.option.meleeStopRange.desc: Stop block ops within this range of target.
lethalbreed.option.meleeStopHeight.desc: Max vertical gap for the melee stop.
Break progress added per tick (/ hardness).
lethalbreed.option.breakGraceTicks.desc: Ticks a break survives without re-request.
lethalbreed.option.blockOpsPerTick.desc: Max world edits per tick per dimension.
lethalbreed.option.breakMaxHardness.desc: Blocks harder than this are unbreakable.
lethalbreed.option.moodEnabled.desc: Master switch for celebrate / flee / regen behaviours.
lethalbreed.option.fleeHealthFraction.de: Drop below this fraction of max HP (with a threat) to start fleeing.
Reach this fraction of max HP to stop fleeing and regen.
lethalbreed.option.regenAmount.desc: Health restored per heal tick while fleeing/celebrating.
lethalbreed.option.fleeThreatRadius.desc: A damager beyond this many blocks stops counting as a threat.
lethalbreed.option.fleeDistance.desc: How far away the fleer aims its retreat path each step.
lethalbreed.option.distressDistance.desc: Distance from the threat before the fleer screams for help.
lethalbreed.option.distressRallyRadius.d: Hearing radius of the distress scream (idle zombies rally in).
lethalbreed.option.celebrateRadius.desc: No other prey within this radius = area clear = celebrate.
lethalbreed.option.celebrateTicks.desc: Duration of the arms-up victory pose (40 = 2s).
lethalbreed.option.screamVolume.desc: Volume of both screams (>1 also widens audible range).
lethalbreed.option.victoryPitch.desc: Pitch of the triumphant victory scream (high).
lethalbreed.option.distressPitch.desc: Pitch of the anguished distress scream (low).
lethalbreed.option.shelterRetryTicks.des: Ticks before a failed shade search is retried, unless the zombie moved more than 4 blocks. 0 disables the cooldown entirely, restoring a full rescan every activation (including the unbounded case for a zombie stuck in water).
lethalbreed.option.packEnabled.desc: Master switch. Off, no pack is ever formed and the per-zombie decision returns immediately.
lethalbreed.option.packCohesionRadius.de: A loose zombie joins a pack whose centroid is within this many blocks.
lethalbreed.option.packBreakRadius.desc: A member drifting beyond this from its pack centroid starts accruing stray activations. Kept well above the cohesion radius so a zombie walking around a wall does not lose its pack.
lethalbreed.option.packFormMinSize.desc: Zombies needed in the neighbourhood before a brand-new pack forms out of nothing.
lethalbreed.option.packMinSize.desc: Below this total membership a pack dissolves, after the grace period.
lethalbreed.option.packMaxSize.desc: Hard cap on members. Also caps a Necromancer's summoning while it is in a pack.
lethalbreed.option.packMinNeighbours.des: Neighbours needed before a lone zombie even considers a pack. This is the “nobody around, so it is pointless” short-circuit.
Consecutive out-of-range activations before a member actually leaves. Pure hysteresis.
lethalbreed.option.packDecisionDivisor.d: A zombie takes a pack decision one activation out of this many. The main CPU dial.
lethalbreed.option.packScanCap.desc: Maximum neighbours inspected per decision. Bounds the cost in a dense horde.
lethalbreed.option.packsPerTick.desc: Packs visited per server tick, round-robin: centroid, merge probe, dissolve check.
lethalbreed.option.packMergeRadius.desc: Two pack centroids closer than this are merge candidates.
lethalbreed.option.packMergeHeadingDot.d: Minimum agreement between the two headings for a merge, from -1 to 1. Without it, packs crossing in opposite directions still fuse and the whole population collapses into one mass.
lethalbreed.option.packDissolveGraceTick: How long a pack may stay under the minimum size before it is dissolved.
Off, packs form and stay cohesive but never pick a destination.
lethalbreed.option.packVirtualSpeed.desc: Blocks per tick for a pack simulated coarsely, out of view. Below walking speed, to pay back the terrain detours a straight line never takes.
lethalbreed.option.packLegMin.desc: Shortest leg of the migration random walk, in blocks.
lethalbreed.option.packLegMax.desc: Longest leg of the migration random walk, in blocks.
lethalbreed.option.packTurnDegrees.desc: Maximum heading change per leg. 0 gives a dead straight line forever. Bounding it is what makes the path read as a migration rather than as aimless wandering.
lethalbreed.option.packDwellTicks.desc: Pause on arrival before choosing the next destination.
Random spread applied to the dwell, so packs do not all move in lockstep.
lethalbreed.option.packArriveDistance.de: How close the pack centroid must get to count as arrived.
lethalbreed.option.packMarchLead.desc: Distance ahead of the centroid where the shared march waypoint is planted. Load-bearing: a lead beyond the LOD tiers would freeze marching members instead of moving them.
Activations a pack may make no headway before it gives up and picks a new destination. This is how walking around an obstacle degrades when there is simply no path.
lethalbreed.option.packMigrateAtDay.desc: Let packs keep migrating in daylight. Off by default: day-sleep wins, so packs travel by night and do not burn under the sun below the immunity phase.
lethalbreed.option.packVirtualEnabled.de: Dematerialise packs nobody can see and restore them on approach. Has its own switch because it is the only part of the system that creates and destroys entities; turning it off leaves packs fully materialised, which simply costs more.
lethalbreed.option.packMaterializeInterv: Ticks between two materialisation sweeps. Each sweep costs one position check per pack, not per zombie.
lethalbreed.option.packDematGraceTicks.d: How long a pack must be out of the entity-ticking area before it is dematerialised. A grace period rather than a timer: chunk unloading has been measured at anywhere from 2 to over 1200 ticks, so one observation proves nothing.
lethalbreed.option.packSpawnSpread.desc: Radius over which a re-materialised pack is scattered, so it does not reappear stacked in one column.
lethalbreed.option.packMaterializeRetrie: How many sweeps a dematerialised member may fail to come back before the pack gives up on it.
lethalbreed.option.packRejoinRadius.desc: How far from its pack a member returning from disk may be and still re-join it.
